_readme: Verified official broadcast-channel registry (Roadmap Phase C1).
Discovery prefers KNOWN official channels and their upload playlists
over broad YouTube search (C2), because videos.list costs 1 quota unit
while search.list is ~100x more expensive (C4). Broad search is a
fallback only.
Each channel scores candidates during broadcast matching (C3): an
official channel adds authority, an unofficial one is penalised. Only
high-confidence candidates auto-link; medium-confidence ones enter
review. `channelId` is null until the real YouTube channel id is
confirmed; a null-id channel is kept disabled so it never drives
discovery on a guess.
`priority` breaks ties when multiple official feeds exist for one match
(higher wins). `allowedEventTypes` restricts a channel to the event
families it actually broadcasts. `language`/`region` feed the preferred
feed selection (Phase E4): one calibrated-layout feed is captured, not
every language.
Fields on every entry (Phase C1):
sourceUrl           candidate/confirmed official channel URL (evidence,
NOT a channel id — ids only come from the live API)
ownershipEvidence    why this URL/id is believed official, incl. the
live-verification provenance once verified
uploadsPlaylistId    confirmed uploads playlist id (from channels.list
contentDetails.relatedPlaylists.uploads); null until
verified
verificationMethod   the exact API call used to confirm the id, e.g.
'YouTube Data API v3 channels.list (forHandle=...)';
null until verified
verifiedDate         last UTC date channelId was confirmed via the
YouTube Data API channels.list (null = never verified)
verifiedStatus       unverified | verified | stale | failed
disabledReason       explicit reason an entry stays disabled (required
whenever enabled=false so a gap is never silent);
null once an entry is verified+enabled
preferredLayout      optional calibrated broadcast-layout id (Phase E4);
null until a layout exists for this feed
VERIFICATION STATUS (2026-07-24): a live GitHub Actions `verify-channels`
dispatch (YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret, channels.list, 1 quota unit) resolved
`ow_esports_global` from its Liquipedia-evidenced sourceUrl
(https://www.youtube.com/OW_Esports) to real channel id
UCiAInBL9kUzz1XRxk66v-gw ('Overwatch Esports'), uploads playlist
UUiAInBL9kUzz1XRxk66v-gw. It is now the ONLY enabled+verified entry.
Every other entry remains disabled: `ow_esports_korea`/`ow_esports_japan`/
`owcs_pacific` have no human-evidenced official URL yet (never guessed —
do not enable without one), and `owcs_china` is bilibili, not YouTube,
and stays explicitly out of scope for the Phase C2 YouTube Data API
client (kept in the registry so coverage reporting shows China as
'unsupported-source' rather than a silent gap). Re-verify any time with
`cli.py verify-channels` (or the discovery workflow's
`mode=verify-channels` dispatch).

channels.name: Overwatch Esports
channels.ownershipEvidence: Originally evidenced from Liquipedia's Overwatch Champions Series page, which lists https://www.youtube.com/OW_Esports as the official YouTube channel alongside the official Twitch (twitch.tv/OW_Esports), Discord, Instagram and X/Twitter accounts, credited to Blizzard Entertainment in partnership with FACEIT/WDG/NetEase. CONFIRMED live via the YouTube Data API on 2026-07-24 (GitHub Actions verify-channels dispatch): channels.list resolved this sourceUrl to channel id UCiAInBL9kUzz1XRxk66v-gw, channel title 'Overwatch Esports', with uploads playlist UUiAInBL9kUzz1XRxk66v-gw. Quota cost: 1 unit.
channels.verificationMethod: YouTube Data API v3 channels.list (resolved via the channel's public handle from sourceUrl) — see docs/YOUTUBE-DISCOVERY.md

channels.name: Overwatch Esports (Korea)
channels.disabledReason: no regional-specific official YouTube channel could be evidenced from sources reachable this pass. Do not guess a separate channel id; the verified global channel (ow_esports_global, UCiAInBL9kUzz1XRxk66v-gw) may itself carry Korea broadcasts. Needs a human-sourced official URL before verify-channels can resolve an id.

channels.disabledReason: no regional-specific official YouTube channel could be evidenced from sources reachable this pass. Do not guess a separate channel id. Needs a human-sourced official URL before verify-channels can resolve an id.

channels.name: OWCS China
channels.disabledReason: platform is bilibili, not YouTube — unsupported by the Phase C2 YouTube Data API client. This entry is kept in the registry so coverage reporting shows China as an explicit coverage_state=unsupported-source region rather than a silent gap; it will never be driven by the YouTube discovery layer.

channels.name: Overwatch Esports (Twitch)
channels.ownershipEvidence: This registry's own ow_esports_global entry records twitch.tv/OW_Esports as an official OWCS broadcast destination, credited to Blizzard Entertainment in partnership with FACEIT/WDG/NetEase, alongside the YouTube channel verified on 2026-07-24. This row makes that recorded destination a first-class source rather than a line of prose.
channels.verificationMethod: yt-dlp on a GitHub-hosted runner (acquire-probe workflow, run 2): --flat-playlist on https://www.twitch.tv/ow_esports/videos listed the channel's recent VODs unauthenticated, and `yt-dlp -g` resolved the newest of them to a playable 720p media URL with no cookies, no API key and no account.
